blind_disposition: Item 1 («漫步果园，穿行椰枣林间» second half rhythmically clipped; proposed 穿行于椰枣林间) REJECTED: the second half is inherited and the batch changed only 绿洲 -> 果园 (two characters for two), so the 4+6 rhythm the reader hears is the approved one; 穿行林间 is idiomatic without 于, and adding it lengthens the h1 for no source reason. Item 21 (footer subjectless and near-repeat of hero; proposed 一片有故事的绿洲，等您漫步果园、穿行椰枣林。) REJECTED: the near-repeat is the source's deliberate structure (ar/en footer repeats the hero); the proposal merges the two source sentences into one and adds an addressee framing (等您) the source does not carry; a subjectless 漫步在…间 is a natural Chinese invitation, stays parallel to the source and keeps orchards. Reader did not stumble on 果园 nor read it against 绿洲. Other items (2-20, 22-25) out of scope, raised to Eyad unscored (items 10 Uqair white vs yellow sand, 13 当前季节, 19 250多万 vs 250万 merit their own check).
